testsuite.name: com.thruhiker.core.gpx.GpxParserTest

testcase.name: trkpt directly under trk is still read
malformed xml is rejected with a useful message
a doctype is refused rather than expanded
an unparseable timestamp is null rather than throwing
a prefixed namespace is matched by local name
waypoints are read with their names
a missing elevation or time is null rather than zero
a timestamp without a zone is read as utc
elevation and time are read from track points
routes are folded in as segments
a non gpx root element is rejected
metadata name and description are read
unusable points are skipped rather than fatal
an empty document parses to an empty track
